text: Hey guys, so many are believing that
America has introduced 18% tariffs. This
tariff will be paid by American
customers. They are the ones who is
going to foot the bill and it's not the
Indian exporters that will get hurt.
This is pure economic madness. It
doesn't work this way. Let me help you
understand by using the example of GST.
Now, on paper GST says that hey, the
price of GST is borne by the customers,
right? Shopkeeper is not getting hurt
because 18% GST or 15% GST, whatever is
being charged by the government, the
shopkeeper is supposed to collect from
you and pay to the government. But think
about it logically that if an item cost
100 rupees and there is a sudden
increase by 15-20% on that item, is the
producer not losing anything or is the
shopkeeper not losing anything? Well,
they are because the demand of that item
is likely to come down. Now, this
happens with almost any other good also
that if for example 18% tariffs are
introduced on Indian goods,
the producers of those Indian goods will
take some part of that tax on themselves
and they will they might increase a
little bit of their price of the product
to reflect it on customers if they can,
but a large part of that tax is borne by
the Indian producer only and this is
what people miss when they start this
trade war debate.
